films.title: MUESTRA ARTISTICA
films.synopsis: "Magia en el Monte" — Mery Palmezzano Muestra artística de apertura · Vernissage QAFF 2026 · Quibdó Magia en el Monte es una instalación inmersiva que transforma el espacio de la Biblioteca Pública Arnoldo Palacios Mosquera en un lugar mítico: una manigua interior donde lo femenino florece en su dimensión más elevada. A través de ilustración y alambrismo, la propuesta invita a quien entra a detenerse, a reconocer la magia que habita en la naturaleza y en las mujeres que la guardan.

films.title: Happy Meal
films.synopsis: DOM, 32, is undergoing therapy. As the Christmas holidays come to an end, he is granted, for the first time in years, the right to spend a day alone with his daughters. A precious day... that he dreads seeing come to an end.

films.synopsis: In the future, an elderly hacker and embroiderer must confront her own traumas and use her skills to escape a virtual reality. This story is based on the life of my grandmother, Leonilia Ferreira.

films.title: The Last Dance
films.synopsis: When Fox's "LA Bar" is hit with a compulsory purchase order, a cornerstone of Caribbean life in 90's East London is threatened. As the city begins to forget, the community remembers.

films.title: VICHE

films.title: Cafe ?
films.synopsis: Ouzin, Baba and Sémou, longtime friends and retirees, never miss their daily coffee meetup. But every year, in April, Sémou is haunted by the loss of his first love. One afternoon, as Ouzin and Baba grow concerned about their friend, Sémou doesn't show up for coffee.

films.title: The Banjo Boys
films.synopsis: The Banjo Boys follows the electrifying rise of Madalitso Band, a Malawian duo—Yobu Maligwa and Yosefe Kalekeni—who built their own instruments into a banjo, a one-stringed babatone (bass), and a foot drum,
films.synopsis_en: The Banjo Boys follows the rise of Madalitso Band, Malawian musicians Yobu Maligwa and Yosefe Kalekeni, who craft a banjo, a one-stringed babatone, and foot drum, creating a sound that moves audiences. Once mocked as madmen in Lilongwe’s streets, they meet Neil Nayar, a British musician drawn to Malawi’s spirit. Their chance encounter sparks a trio, propelling them from local busking to global stages like Sauti za Busara, WOMAD, and Joshua Tree. Facing visa struggles, personal tragedies—including original member Rice’s imprisonment for murder—and cultural tensions, their grit fuels joyous performances. Yobu’s pastoral visions, Yosefe’s resilience, and Neil’s purpose drive their bond. Their minimalist sound bridges continents, culminating in a 2023 world tour and a legendary Malawi homecoming. Intimate interviews and vibrant performances reveal music’s power to unite and transform.

films.title: DIÁLOGO IMPROBABLE  ·  NOIR IDENTIDAD
films.synopsis: Ser negro no es un género: identidades complejas entre la vitrina y la pantalla NOIR Identidad explora la negritud como identidad compleja, múltiple e irreductible a una sola definición. ¿Cómo se cura una identidad en un museo? ¿Cómo se filma sin reducirla? El curador que construye vitrinas vs. el cineasta que construye planos vs. el artista que trabaja con imagen y objeto vs. el gestor cultural que diseña los espacios donde las identidades caben o no caben. Pregunta central: ¿cómo se representa dignamente la diversidad negra sin esencializarla, simplificarla ni traicionarla? PANELISTAS: Dra. Patricia Mena, César A. Palacios Chaverra, Nicola Vizcaíno, Museo Afro de Colombia

films.title: The One who Cries
films.synopsis: A shepherdess is convinced by her childhood friend, who has become a seller of fake medicines, to go and retrieve the goods that a spirit supposedly stole from her. In fact, a rumor is circulating that a demon is prowling the streets of Abidjan: "The Weeper."

films.title: Mojugba
films.synopsis: Fanny, an Afro-Colombian leader, turns the Mojugba, a Yoruba ritual of ancestral invocation, into an act of resistance. In a country that tries to erase its history, she teaches that remembering is revolutionary.

films.title: Sisters in Destiny: Angela Davis & Gerty Archimede
films.synopsis: Two women. Two continents. One shared fight. From Guadeloupe to the United States, Sisters in Destiny explores the intertwined journeys of Gerty Archimède, a trailblazer of feminism.

films.synopsis: Teyo, a trans girl, gets ready to start at her new all-girls school. As she journeys through Quibdó, a warm and vibrant city, she navigates the rhythms and gazes that greet her before stepping into class.
films.synopsis_en: Teyo, a young trans woman, prepares to enter her new female school. In the middle of a trip through Quibdó, a hot city of sound, rhythms and glances that she faces before entering class converge.

films.synopsis: Defiance, strength, bravery, love, and loss—these are the heart of Amelia's story. More than just a tale about our protagonist, it is uniquely told through her perspective. As a married Nigerian woman living in relative poverty in the year 2002.

films.title: Soñé su nombre
films.synopsis: Después de 30 años negando su dolor, Ángela se enfrenta a su pasado cuando su padre se le aparece en un sueño y le pide que lo busque. Junto a su hermana Juliana, emprende un viaje por Colombia hasta los terriotiros indígenas donde su padre, un agricultor afrodescendiente, fue víctima de desaparición forzada.
films.synopsis_en: Thirty years after his forced disappearance, the filmmaker’s Afro Colombian father comes to her in a dream, asking her to find him. With her sister, she sets out on a journey of discovery across Colombia’s painful history, reconnecting with their father and his activism.

films.title: Three Black Men
films.synopsis: ¿Puede un viaje hacia el pasado abrir nuevas posibilidades para la Negritud? Tres hombres negros recorren a la inversa la ruta transatlántica del comercio de esclavos, de Los Ángeles (California) a Salvador de Bahía (Brasil) y, finalmente, a Accra (Ghana). En este recorrido exploran aspectos fundamentales de la historia negra y las representaciones de la migración forzosa, la supervivencia y la desaparición de los millones de personas que cruzaron el Atlántico; y brazan la identidad negra como una fuente viva de conexión, creación y renovación.
films.synopsis_en: Can blackness escape the violence of its origins?  Three Black men set out on a transformative journey along the transatlantic slave route in reverse, exploring resistance, liberation and a new understanding of Blackness.  Their epic voyage takes them from Los Angeles to Salvador da Bahia in Brazil, and finally to Accra in Ghana. Their mission is to redefine Blackness, heal from historical trauma, and envision new paths to liberation beyond the constraints of white supremacy.

films.title: Nunkui
films.synopsis: Nunkui lives in a Shuar community and dreams of the feminine spirit of the garden, also called Nunkui, just like her. While her aunt teaches her songs and the secrets of cultivation, the vast Amazon rainforest they call home is handed over to transnational mining companies, and evictions begin in the area.
films.synopsis_en: Nunkui, the female spirit of the garden. Nunkui, the name of a Shuar girl in a lush world of plants, animals, spirits and an extended family. Between premonitory dreams and mining conflicts in the Amazonian Cóndor mountain range, Nunkui searches for her place in the world, influenced by her grandfather Yaunchu, an old Shuar leader.

films.title: The Clay Vase
films.synopsis: Where do we keep our memories? Where do they endure? How do we evoke them? An epiphany dispels forgetfulness and reconstructs the bond between Esther, the protagonist, and her ancestors through the world of dreams, her mother's memories, and the restoration of an inherited clay vessel.

films.title: Of Mud and Blood

films.title: Mi viche todo el dia
films.synopsis: In the Medio Atrato region of Chocó, Ana Panesso and her community grow sugarcane and produce viche, an ancestral beverage once prohibited and now in vogue.
films.synopsis_en: In the Medio Atrato region of Chocó, Ana Panesso and her community grow sugarcane and make viche, an ancestral beverage that was once prohibited but now is in vogue. Through food, river trips, and music, viche and its knowledge not only shape people s daily lives but also raise the question of a just future, where viche serves as food, sustenance, and identity for Black families.

films.title: DIÁLOGO IMPROBABLE  ·  NOIR HISTÓRICO
films.synopsis: Las sombras del archivo: memoria negra entre el museo y el cine La historia afrodescendiente ha sido contada desde los archivos coloniales, la Inquisición y los registros de esclavización. El Museo Afro rastrea esas memorias en archivos nacionales para restituirlas. El cine NOIR Histórico hace lo mismo: ilumina lo que fue deliberadamente oscurecido. ¿Qué ocurre cuando el curador, la documentalista, el director de teatro y la especialista en salud mental y políticas públicas se encuentran frente al mismo archivo? El museo desclasifica y expone; el cine reanima y resignifica; la política pública mide el daño y diseña la reparación.
